not_rebuilt.reason: Not compared yet, because verify compares Markdown line by line by position. Today's compare-run.ts (commit ad71156b88, #92, 2026-10-26) inserts one sensitivity row under each of the six comparisons and an 'Excluded pairs: none.' line under each per-task table, which pushes every later line down. A rebuild by hand on 2026-11-09 gave every published line unchanged, in the same order, with only those 10 lines added; the same numbers are compared in comparisons.gbrain.continuity-synthesis-corrections-approval_relay.json.

Not compared yet, because verify compares JSON lists and Markdown lines by position. Today's secondary-endpoints.ts (commit ad71156b88, #92, 2026-10-26) adds a sixth endpoint, cross_scope_fact (all zeros here, since this run ingested no facts), third in the list, so the five published endpoints each move down one place and show as about 130 differences. A rebuild by hand on 2026-11-09 gave all five published endpoints identical when matched by name, and the Markdown unchanged apart from the 11 lines of the new table.

Each shard's spend sheet came from scripts/reconcile-provider.ts run on that shard's own results folder before the shards were merged. That script only reads files named exactly trials.jsonl, proxy-usage.ndjson and ledger.sqlite in one folder, and the committed copies are the merged trials.jsonl plus the shard's files under a prefix (for example oc-s-none.ledger.sqlite), so the shard's own inputs aren't laid out the way the script needs.
